page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-96 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the n4d server family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture and is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory. This configuration maintains a balanced resource distribution of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. Additionally, the n4d-standard-96 does not feature integrated GPU hardware accelerators, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the n4d-standard-96 offers a high-density allocation of dedicated compute and memory resources suitable for enterprise-scale workloads. The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this server type appropriate for multi-threaded applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose enterprise applications that require significant parallel processing capabilities without specialized memory or GPU acceleration.
